products.title: The Aqua
description: Introducing The Aqua, a contemporary shirt designed for the modern wardrobe. Crafted with precision and style, this piece seamlessly transitions from casual days to elevated occasions.

Featuring a refined cut that flatters various body types, The Aqua offers comfort without compromising on sophistication. The aqua-inspired palette brings a fresh, calming aesthetic that pairs effortlessly with both neutral and bold accents.
Premium fabric construction ensures durability and ease of care, making it a reliable staple for everyday wear. Whether styled solo or layered, The Aqua delivers versatility and timeless appeal.

Perfect for layering or wearing as a standalone piece, The Lanes adapts to your personal style. An essential addition for anyone seeking versatile, well-made basics that transition seamlessly across seasons and settings.

products.title: The Sepal

A must-have investment piece for those who value quality basics and timeless fashion.

products.title: Petal Shirt
description: This vibrant short-sleeved button-up shirt features a bold color palette and striking design. The upper half is a fiery orange-red hue, gradually fading into a soft white tie-dye effect toward the bottom. A large black symmetrical floral or sunburst-inspired pattern decorates the front, adding a strong visual element. The relaxed fit and classic collar make it both stylish and comfortable, ideal for making a statement in warm weather.

products.title: Terra Dye Shirt
description: This is a short-sleeved button-up shirt with a bold, earthy aesthetic. The upper half is a warm, rusty terracotta shade, while the lower half features a white tie-dye effect, creating a striking contrast. The relaxed fit and camp collar add to its casual yet stylish appeal, making it perfect for a laid-back yet confident look. The fabric appears lightweight, making it ideal for warm weather.

products.title: Tarkashi Shirt
description: This white short-sleeved button-up shirt blends classic elegance with subtle yet intricate details. The standout design features hand-painted Fleur-de-lis motifs symmetrically placed on both sides of the front panel, adding a regal and sophisticated touch. A decorative bead-like embroidery runs along the button placket, enhancing the shirt’s refined aesthetic. The lightweight fabric and relaxed fit make it perfect for both casual and semi-formal wear, offering a balance of comfort and style.

products.title: Florae Shirt
description: This is a white, short-sleeved button-up shirt with a relaxed fit and a classic camp collar. The fabric appears to be lightweight, possibly linen or cotton, making it breathable and ideal for warm weather. The standout feature is the scattered, hand-stitched crochet floral appliqués in soft pastel shades of blue, green, and cream, adding a charming, artisanal touch. The buttons have a decorative metallic design, enhancing the shirt’s vintage-inspired aesthetic.

products.title: Scallop Shirt
description: This elegant light blue short-sleeved button-up shirt blends classic tailoring with delicate details. The fabric features subtle vertical stripes, adding a refined texture. A standout feature is the scalloped embroidery running alongside the button placket, giving it a soft and artistic touch. The decorative buttons, including elephant motifs, enhance the uniqueness of the piece. The structured collar and relaxed fit make it versatile for both formal and casual wear.

products.title: Pleated Solara Shirt
description: The shirt is a white, short-sleeved button-up with a classic pointed collar. It features a pleated design on the upper chest area, accentuated by a vibrant, abstract pattern in warm tones of orange, yellow, and red. The fabric appears lightweight, making it suitable for warm weather. The buttons are small and delicate, blending subtly into the design.

products.title: Waffle Shirt
description: This waffle weave shirt is the perfect summer piece, blending comfort and style effortlessly. Made from lightweight, breathable fabric, it’s ideal for staying cool in warm weather. The button-down design and Cuban collar add a relaxed, fashionable touch, making it essential for casual summer clothes. The unique texture of the waffle weave fabric enhances its cool, airy feel while giving the shirt a distinct, modern look. Featuring vibrant embroidery in accent orange on the side, this shirt adds a bold detail to your summer wardrobe. Perfect for both daywear and evening outings, it’s a must-have summer shirt.
Size: Small | Medium | Large | X-large

products.title: Reverse Reverie
description: This long denim coat is the perfect winter wardrobe essential for women, offering both style and functionality. Made from high-quality denim fabric, it features a sturdy, classic design on one side, with traditional stitching, pockets, and a timeless blue wash. The reverse side is equally stylish, featuring a softer, smoother fabric that offers a more refined look. This reversible coat allows you to switch between two fashionable looks depending on your mood or the occasion. Ideal for cold weather, it provides warmth and comfort while adding a fashionable edge to your winter clothes collection. A versatile, must-have female coat.
